discordances.dockle_alert: CIS-DI-0006 INFO: not found HEALTHCHECK statement

discordances.intended_difference: ConUnit also fails a volume below /dev, /proc or /sys, for example /proc/self. Dockle compares the exact paths /dev, /proc and /sys, so a trailing slash or a subpath is missed.

discordances.dockle_alert: CIS-DI-0007 FATAL: Always combine 'apt-get update' with 'apt-get install|upgrade' : /bin/sh -c apt-get update
discordances.intended_difference: Dockle splits a command on && only and matches any two of the tokens apt-get, apt and update in a segment, so mentions in echo, in arguments or after a semicolon count. ConUnit tokenizes on &&, ||, ; and | and newlines and counts a command in command position only.

FS-01 checks the merged filesystem for the cache and hygiene paths (/var/cache/apt, /var/cache/apk, /root/.cache, /.git, /root/.ssh, /.env and /var/lib/apt/lists), whatever step created them. Dockle's two checkpoints judge only the recorded apk add and apt commands.

discordances.dockle_alert: CIS-DI-0010 FATAL: Suspicious filename found : app/id_rsa (You can suppress it with "-af id_rsa") | Suspicious ENV key found : DB_PASSWORD on /bin/sh -c #(nop) ENV DB_PASSWORD=******* GPG_KEY=abc123 PLAIN=value (You can suppress it with --accept-key)
discordances.intended_difference: Dockle fails on a credential file name alone, for example id_rsa, with no content check and no fixture exemption. ConUnit passes when the file holds no private key block or when every finding is under a fixture-like path or is a Debian snakeoil key.

discordances.dockle_alert: DKL-DI-0003 WARN: Avoid dist-upgrade in container : /bin/sh -c true apt-get dist-upgrade
discordances.intended_difference: Dockle matches any two of the tokens apt-get, apt and dist-upgrade in a segment, so a mention in an argument or an echo counts. ConUnit requires the command form apt-get dist-upgrade or apt dist-upgrade.

discordances.dockle_alert: DKL-DI-0005 FATAL: Use 'rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists' after 'apt-get install|update' : /bin/sh -c true apt-get update
discordances.intended_difference: Dockle reports an apk add without --no-cache, or an apt update or install without a later removal of /var/lib/apt/lists, in the recorded commands. ConUnit passes when the final filesystem holds none of its listed paths, for example after a cleanup in a later step.
